Loading Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

Import NSDUH

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url)

drug_use_html
```

Pull the tables out 

```{r}
marj_df = 
  drug_use_html |>
  html_table() |>
  first() |> #this function tells R that we want the first element of a list 
  slice(-1) 
```

## import some SW data

Pull in the html 

```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
```

Next up... selector gadget 

```{r}
swm_title_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |>
  html_text() 

swm_metascore_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |>
  html_text() 

swm_runtime_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".base .ipc-inline-list__item:nth-child(2)") |>
  html_text() 

swm_df = 
  tibble(
    title = swm_title_vec,
    score = swm_metascore_vec,
    runtime = swm_runtime_vec
  )
```
